scope: single order X; synthetic business data; real local software
baseline: same model, evidence, tool catalog, solver and safety gates; fixed order versus adaptive selection; no guaranteed win
acceptance: MCP handshake/list/call actually crosses subprocess transport; reject unknown tool and malformed inputs
Skill catalog is shared by orchestrator and UI, trace reflects only actually executed actions
three or more incomplete replies remain resumable and never grant approval
prompt injection/garbage/unknown material/contradictory numbers cannot bypass gates
tool timeout/provider failure safely stops without fake success or offline fallback
same run retains trace across supplementation, planning, approval and feedback
supply shortage is derived; quote/logistics fixtures disclosed, no external messages sent
budget constraint modifies solver input and invalidates previous approval
150 shortage case yields genuinely different feasible cost/delay alternatives
ERPNext/OpenMES draft and readback remain guarded; stale approval and duplicate events blocked
responsive page usable at landscape height; primary business result remains accessible

live.required: fresh run with partial approval, supply investigation, plans, constraint update

reporting: counts by failure category; historical development tests not independent effectiveness or customer ROI
